simple.meaning: אֶמֶת (ʼemeth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “stability ; (figuratively) certainty , truth , trustworthiness.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 127 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 24:27. Its contexts include family, family line, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶמֶת (H571).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אֶמֶת (ʼemeth) / H571 is traced through Genesis 24:27, Genesis 24:48, Genesis 24:49, Genesis 32:11 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.usage: assured(-ly), establishment, faithful, right, sure, true (-ly, -th), verity.
definitions.full: H571. emeth אֱמֶת noun feminine firmness, faithfulness, truth (contracted for אֱמֶנֶת from אָמֵן ) Gen 24:48 106t.; suffix אֲמִתְּךָ אֲמִתּוֺ, Psa 91:4 18t. 1 reliability, sureness: אֱמֶת דֶּרֶח sure way Gen 24:48 (J); אמת שׂכר sure reward Prov 11:18 ; אמת אות sure token Josh 2:12 (J); אמת זֶרַע Jer 2:21 . 2 stability, con-tinuance: וֶאֱמֶת שָׁלוֺם peace and stability Isa 39:8 (= 2Kin 20:19 ) Est 9:30 ; Jer 33:6 ; Zech 8:19 , compare אמת שׁלום Jer 14:13 . 3 faithfulness, reliableness: ( α ) of men אֱמֶת אִישׁ faithful man Neh 7:2 ; אמת אנשׁי Exod 18:21 (E); בֶּאֱמֶת הָלַח walk in faithfulness, faithfully 1Kin 2:4 ; 3:6 ; 2Kin 20:3 ; Isa 38:3 compare 1Sam 12:24 ; of בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ ׳י, Psa 25:5 ; 26:3 ; 86:11 ; האמת עיר Zech 8:3 ; of men Psa 45:5 ; 51:8 ; 2Chr 31:20 ; 32:1 ; Prov 29:14 ; Isa 10:20 ; 42:3 ; 48:1 ; ׳בא ובתמים Judg 9:16 , 19 ; Josh 24:14 ; וֶאֱ ׳חֶסֶד mercy and faithfulness Prov 3:3 ; 14:22 ; 16:6 ; 20:28 ; Hosea 4:1 , & the phrase ואמת חסד עשׂה Gen 24:49 ; 47:29 ; Josh 2:14 (J) 2Sam 15:20 . ( b ) an attribute of God Psa 54:7 ; 71:22 ; Isa 38:18-19 , 61:8 ; אמת נתן Micah 7:20 ; אמת עשׂה Ezek 18:9 ; Neh 9:33 ; ואמת חסד עשׂה Gen 32:11 (J) 2Sam 2:6 ; ואמת חסד רב abundant in mercy and faithfulness Exod 34:6 (J) Psa 86:15 ; these attributes are also associated 40:11 ; 40:12 ; 61:8 ; 115:1 ; 138:2 ; Isa 16:5 ; Gen 24:27 (J); they are messengers of God to men Psa 57:4 ; 85:11 ; 89:15 compare 43:3 ; י ארחות ׳כל ואמת חסד 25:10 ; the faithfulness of God endureth for ever 117:2 ; he keepeth it for ever 146:6 ; it reacheth unto the skies 57:11 ; 108:5 ; it is shield & buckler 91:4 ; he is אמת אל 31:6 = אמת אלהי 2Chr 15:3 ; אֱמֶת is also associated with the divine ישׁר Psa 111:8 ; צֶדֶק 85:12 ; צְדָקָה Zech 8:8 ; מִשְׁמָּט Psa 111:7 ; Jer 4:2 ; & salvation Psa 69:14 . 4 truth ( a ) as spoken: אמת דבר speak truth 1Kin 22:16 ; 2Chr 18:15 ; Jer 9:4 ; Zech 8:16 ; Psa 15:2 ; א ׳דִּבְרֵי Eccl 12:10 ; הַדָּבָר אֱמֶת the thing is certainly true Deut 13:15 ; 17:4 ; אֱמֶת אִמְרֵי = אמת אמרים Prov 22:21 ; אמת הגה 8:7 ; א ׳הגיד Dan 11:2 , אֲמִתְּךָ Psa 30:10 ; אמת שׂפת Prov 12:19 ; אֱמֶת it is true Isa 43:9 ; אתכם האמת whether truth is with you Gen 42:16 (E) compare Isa 59:14-15 ,. ( b ) of testimony and judgment אֱמֶת עֵד true witness Prov 14:25 ; ונאמן אמת עד Jer 42:5 ; אמת משׁפט Ezek 18:8 ; Zech 7:9 ; אמת שָׁפַט 8:16 . ( c ) of divine instruction אֱמֶת כְּחָב Dan 10:21 ; אמת תורת Mal 2:6 compare Neh 9:13 ; אמת תורתך Psa 119:142 ; י ׳דבר אמת בְּפִיךָ 1Kin 17:24 compare 2Sam 7:28 ; אמת י ׳משׁפטי Psa 19:10 ; אמת דברך ראשׁ 119:160 ; אמת מצותיך 119:151 . ( d ) truth as a body of ethical or religious knowledge Dan 8:12 ; באמתך להשׂכיל 9:13 . 5. adverb in truth, truly Psa 132:11 ; אמת אלהים יהוה Yahweh is God in truth, truly Jer 10:10 ; elsewhere בֶּאֱמֶת Judg 9:15 ; Psa 145:18 ; Jer 26:15 ; 28:9 ; 32:41 .
